/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
x=json.loads(Path(\"input.json\").read_text())
a=sorted(x[\"actions\"],key=lambda a:a[\"id\"])
feasible=[]
for mask in range(1<<len(a)):
    chosen=[a[i] for i in range(len(a)) if mask>>i&1]
    ids=[v[\"id\"] for v in chosen]
    selected=set(ids)
    cost=sum(v[\"cost\"] for v in chosen)
    if cost>x[\"budget\"]:continue
    if any(not set(v[\"requires\"])<=selected for v in chosen):continue
    if any(set(pair)<=selected for pair in x[\"incompatible\"]):continue
    losses={s[\"id\"]:max(0,s[\"base_loss\"]-sum(s[\"reductions\"][i] for i in ids)-sum(b[\"reduction\"] for b in s[\"bonuses\"] if set(b[\"actions\"])<=selected)) for s in sorted(x[\"scenarios\"],key=lambda s:s[\"id\"])}
    worst=max(losses.values())
    weighted=sum(losses[s[\"id\"]]*s[\"weight\"] for s in x[\"scenarios\"])
    feasible.append(((worst,weighted,cost,ids),losses))
feasible.sort(key=lambda p:p[0])
k,losses=feasible[0]
print(json.dumps({\"actions\":k[3],\"cost\":k[2],\"scenario_losses\":losses,\"worst_loss\":k[0],\"weighted_loss\":k[1],\"feasible_portfolios\":len(feasible)},sort_keys=False))
print(\"Leading objective tuples:\",json.dumps([p[0] for p in feasible[:5]]))'"
